senses.gloss: (f.?) (= h. אֶדֶן; cmp. b. h. הֲדֹם; √דא, דנא; cmp. דּוּךְ) foot-stool, camp-chair, folding stool.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 43:10">Targ. Jer. XLIII, 10</cite> <he>אוּדְנֵיה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אפדניה</he>).—Pl. <he>אוּדְנַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="A00402"><he>אֲדִינַיָּא</he></cite>. Targ. II <cite ref="Esther 1:2">Est. I, 2</cite> <he>תרתין אוּדְנוֹי</he> (<he>תרין</he>?) the double footstool of king Solomon.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 8:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 6</cite> <he>מָטָה וישן וכ׳</he> (not <he>מיטה</he>) when it bends in (under the weight) but one can sleep on it; if it was originally so made, <cite ref="I00531"><he>טמאה</he></cite> (not <cite ref="I00100"><he>טהורה</he></cite>) it is unclean <he>מפני שהיא כאו׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="A00402"><he>אדיניא</he></cite>, ed. <cite ref="A00387"><he>אדוניא</he></cite>) because it is made like a double footstool.
